# American Sports Medicine Institute (ASMI)

> > Leading sports medicine education and research organization offering CME/CEU conferences on orthopaedic surgery, athletic training, and rehabilitation.

ASMI, based in Birmingham, Alabama, provides weekly continuing education conferences at the Bruno Conference Center covering surgical techniques, rehabilitation protocols, and sports injury management. The institute offers AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and BOC-approved CEU credits for physicians, athletic trainers, and physical therapists.

## Key Topics

- CME/CEU continuing education credits
- Orthopaedic sports medicine
- Athletic training and rehabilitation
- Surgical techniques and arthroscopy
- Sports injury assessment and treatment
- Glenn Fleisig (biomechanics research)
- Andrews Sports Medicine & Orthopaedic Center
- AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- Board of Certification (BOC)
- Bruno Conference Center
- ACL and rotator cuff repair
- Throwing athlete biomechanics
- Lower extremity injuries
- Spine and joint disorders

## Surgical Techniques & Arthroscopy

- [Elbow Arthroscopy: Indication and Technique](https://asmi.org/event/elbow-arthroscopy-indication-and-technique): CME/CEU event on elbow arthroscopy surgical techniques at Bruno Center
- [Arthroscopic Acromioplasty: Indication & Technique](https://asmi.org/event/arthroscopic-acromioplasty-indication-technique-4): CME conference on shoulder arthroscopic acromioplasty surgical technique

## Rehabilitation & Recovery Protocols

- [Rehabilitation Following Rotator Cuff Repair](https://asmi.org/event/rehabilitation-following-rotator-cuff-repair): CME event covering rotator cuff repair rehabilitation protocols
- [Rehab Following ACL Surgery](https://asmi.org/event/rehab-following-acl-surgery-2): CEU conference on ACL surgery rehabilitation protocols and recovery
- [Rehab of Thoracic Outlet Syndrome](https://asmi.org/event/rehab-of-thoracic-outlet-syndrome): CEU conference on thoracic outlet syndrome rehabilitation protocols

## Throwing Athlete & Overhead Sports

- [Biomechanics, Physical Exam and Treatment of the Thrower's Shoulder part I](https://asmi.org/event/biomechanics-physical-exam-and-treatment-of-the-throwers-shoulder-part-i): CEU event on thrower's shoulder biomechanics by Glenn Fleisig

## Lower Extremity Injuries

- [Foot and Ankle Injuries in Sports](https://asmi.org/event/foot-and-ankle-injuries-in-sports): CME/CEU event on foot and ankle injury diagnosis and treatment
- [Stress Fractures of the Lower Extremity](https://asmi.org/event/stress-fractures-of-the-lower-extremity-2): CME/CEU event on lower extremity stress fracture management
- [Patellofemoral Disorders](https://asmi.org/event/patellofemoral-disorders-2): Weekly CEU conference on patellofemoral disorder assessment and care

## Joint & Spine Disorders

- [Femoroacetabular Impingement (FAI)](https://asmi.org/event/femoroacetabular-impingement-fai-2): CME conference on hip FAI diagnosis and treatment approaches
- [Osteochondritis Dissecans](https://asmi.org/event/osteochondritis-dissecans-2): Weekly CME/CEU conference on osteochondritis dissecans management
- [Cervical Spine Injuries: Assessment & Treatment](https://asmi.org/event/cervical-spine-injuries-assessment-treatment-3): CME/CEU conference on cervical spine injury assessment and treatment

## Optional

- [Abdominal and Genitourinary Injuries in Sports](https://asmi.org/event/abdominal-and-genitourinary-injuries-in-sports): Weekly CME/CEU conference on sports-related abdominal/GU injuries
- [The Female Athlete](https://asmi.org/event/the-female-athlete): CME/CEU conference on female athlete-specific sports medicine topics
- [From Fellowship to Practice](https://asmi.org/event/from-fellowship-to-practice-3): CME/CEU conference on transitioning from fellowship to practice
- [Radiology Conference - Mortality/Morbidity](https://asmi.org/event/radiology-conference-mortality-morbidity-11): CME radiology conference with mortality/morbidity case presentations
